resources.string: Choose a Pokémon and a level and leave this cheat enabled. It starts off in game: press L+R to turn it on, release both buttons and press them again to turn it off. Walk in tall grass. No Balls are used. Turn off Wild levels in the game options. Other known species and level modifiers will be disabled. If you previously used an old species or level code, restart the game once before using this selector. Restarting or loading a state turns the selector off again.
Unown requires a completed Ruins of Alph puzzle.
